title: Desktop Coder start fails: "the granted source snapshot is unavailable or changed"
body:
Owner, 2026-09-30 22:51, Mac app built from 716609e238 (host restarted on it): a chat dispatched Coder (Codex · gpt-6-luna, project `openagents` → worktree `~/.openagents/worktrees/openagents-765fcd1a4d5a`, project folder `~/work/openagents-host-tasks`, a linked worktree of `~/work/openagents`), and the start card was followed by **Coder didn't finish — Coder did not start: the granted source snapshot is unavailable or changed**. Launch log: `~/.openagents/tasks/repository-launch-765fcd1a4d5a…jsonl` → `{"error":"the granted source snapshot is unavailable or changed","cause":"admission"}`. Raised in `crates/coder/src/task/adapter.rs` (~L630) when `Snapshot::observe` is incomplete or differs from `grant.expected_source_snapshot`.

An earlier run in the same setup (worktree `openagents-host-tasks-7b7952b88b77`, build 1ebd5e20f7) started fine, so suspect a regression from #10073 (linked worktrees named after their repo), #10066 (task media), #10076, or #10077. Find which (incomplete snapshot vs. pin mismatch, and why), fix, add a regression test reproducing a desktop local run from a linked-worktree project, and make the failure message say which (and what file/limit) so it's diagnosable.
